derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a cognate of G2240 (ἥκω);
def: to arrive upon, i.e. extend to

occurrences.text: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
